Mountain Tribe.description: Hardened by harsh frost-peaked environments, specializing in endurance against severe weather and physical wear.

features.name: Frost-Born Resilience
features.tldr: You gain resistance to cold damage and ignore difficult terrain caused by snow or ice.

Plainstrider.description: Nomadic hunters of wide-open steppes, specializing in tracking, speed, and mounted combat.

features.name: Steppe Momentum
features.tldr: Your base walking speed increases by 5 feet, and you gain proficiency in the Survival skill.
